ruleName: Ball hits the flagstick or the person tending it

title: Flagstick Used To Stop The Ball – What's The Penalty?
question: If the flagstick is deliberately placed behind the hole to stop your ball, and your ball hits it, what is the ruling?

choices.text: No penalty, play as it lies
Two penalty strokes and you must replay the stroke
Move the flagstick and keep playing
Add one penalty stroke and continue

explanation: If someone sets the flagstick behind the hole on purpose to stop the ball and your ball hits it, you get a two stroke penalty and must replay the shot, as the previous stroke does not count.
